answer: Each registered identity must lock a 500-token bond and hold one hardware credential whose signed attestation includes a quill digest bound to a single physical chip. A forged identity locks 500 tokens, forfeits 100% on challenge, and waits 30 epochs before the bond unlocks. Splitting one credential into k fakes costs 500k tokens plus shared slashing, and independent jurors detect reuse by matching quill digests, garden logs, and nectar traces.
